guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: Errors are concentrated at frontend (frontend-external_error z=+537) and checkoutservice spans, but latency actually dropped across the board and workload fell sharply in most services, so the load drop looks like a symptom of failing requests. The only resource anomalies in a callee of checkoutservice and frontend are currencyservice_socket (+39%, z=+7.8) and currencyservice_mem (+31%), and the single paymentservice error log is not enough to point elsewhere.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect currencyservice connection handling (open sockets/connection leaks) and checkoutservice->currencyservice call errors, then restart currencyservice if sockets are confirmed leaking. Non-destructive: a rolling restart of a stateless service.
